origin: Benchmark-defined ideal periodic model, NOT a source measured chirality or source CIF
coverage: One intact neutral source molecule per 12 primitive repeats; same for all three molecules
model_limit: Source XFS22 SWCNT reports diameter 1–2 nm and length 5–30 um, with no single chirality; conclusions are conditional on (10,10).
mapping: Tube indices 1..480 from extxyz; append molecule atoms in original XYZ row order. Repeat control maps cell0 and cell1 explicitly.

controls.length_fixed_coverage: 24 repeats with two mapped adsorbates; compare per-molecule energy and work function at same density
controls.dilution_optional: 24 repeats with one adsorbate changes coverage and is not a size-only control
controls.vacuum: Increase transverse vacuum from 18 to 24 angstrom per side; test radial electrostatic plateau
controls.kpoints: Converge reciprocal sampling along tube at equal reciprocal spacing between supercells
controls.poses: At least two independent pi-face/axial orientations per molecule; initially place nearest heavy atoms 3.2 angstrom outside tube surface, then relax
